name: install_github
title: Attempts to install a package directly from GitHub.

origin.description: Download a GitHub repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_github(repo, ref = "HEAD", subdir = NULL, auth_token = github_pat(quiet), host = "api.github.com", dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: repo
arguments.text: A GitHub specification such as username/repo, or package=username/repo[@ref].

arguments.name: ref
arguments.text: Branch, tag, or commit. HEAD is the default branch. A ref inside repo wins.

arguments.name: auth_token
arguments.text: GitHub token. The default is GITHUB_PAT, then GITHUB_TOKEN. NULL skips both.

arguments.name: host
arguments.text: GitHub API host. The default is api.github.com.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The tarball URL is the GitHub API archive for the ref. A download error is caught. quiet hides the message and the call returns NULL.
origin.value: The package name, or NULL when the download fails.
origin.example: install_github("praise=gaborcsardi/praise", auth_token = NULL, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Download a GitHub repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_github(repo, ref='HEAD', subdir=None, auth_token=None, host='api.github.com', dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.text: Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. The default token is GITHUB_PAT, then GITHUB_TOKEN. The git credential store is not read.
translation.value: A list of package names, or None when the download fails.
